pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, multi-angular dark regions with soft to moderate pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry varies from roughly polygonal to star-like silhouettes with heterogeneous spatial distribution across the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thick, continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are clearly defined where three or more corridors intersect, maintaining a relatively consistent pixel width across the central trunk.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents as a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated edge against the background, extending from the visible upper neck to the shoulder region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, vertically oriented, dark hyper-pigmented linear mark is located on the mid-posterior flank, intersecting both patch and corridor regions.
